# Funky Dirt — full reference

> Funky Dirt is a three-member Sri Lankan funk, pop and rap band from Colombo, formed in 2007 by Mura, Shenal and Ridzy. This page collects the band's verified facts, discography, booking information and official links in one plain-text file for AI assistants and answer engines.

Canonical website: https://funkydirtmusic.com/
Content language: English
Last updated: 2026-11-04

Important: funkydirtmusic.com is an unofficial, fan-made information site. Music, artwork, videos and trademarks belong to Funky Dirt and their respective labels. For official announcements, use the band's verified channels listed at the end of this file.

## Band overview

- Name: Funky Dirt
- Alternate spellings: FunkyDirt, FunKy DirT
- Origin: Colombo, Sri Lanka
- Formed: 2007
- Earlier name: MACS, a school band at Isipathana College, Colombo
- Members: Murshad Huvais (Mura), Shenal Maddumage, Ridzy
- Genres: funk, pop, dance, rap, island pop, Sinhala pop
- Sound: a melting pot of funk, rap, dance and island pop, with lyrics that move between comedy and heartfelt storytelling
- Notable awards: Best New Artist and Best Upcoming Artist, earned after the release of the Ada Ape Thaththa music video

## Members

### Murshad Huvais — "Mura"

Role: vocalist, lyricist and rapper.
Mura is the voice and pen of Funky Dirt. He writes the lyrics, performs the rap verses and fronts the band's live shows. His writing ranges from viral one-liners to full love letters in Sinhala.

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mura_funkydirt/

### Shenal Maddumage — "Shenal"

Role: producer, composer and mixing engineer.
Shenal builds the beats, produces the records and handles mixing and mastering. He is the sonic engineer behind the Funky Dirt sound.

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shenal_funkydirt/

### Ridzy — "Ridzy"

Role: DJ and beatmaker.
Ridzy sets the energy for Funky Dirt's live shows with turntable-driven performances that turn concerts into dance parties.

Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ridzy_funkydirt/

## Discography and notable songs

The following releases are the band's most notable and are linked to official streaming pages.

1. Sereppuwa — 2026 single featuring Aruja AJ. Lyrics by Murshad Huvais; music by Shenal Maddumage. The official video has passed 1.3 million YouTube views.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/5A16odAsBtHavDJs5inAWH
   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Snp5X_zjBZY

2. Oba Dakmen — 2025 single. Used as the PPL official theme song.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/15PTikg4LcYtyEYMtGrzpF

3. Arume Balapan — 2025 single. Available on the band's official streaming profiles.

4. Watey Gihin — Funky Dirt with Murshad Huvais and Shenal Maddumage.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/4nX06dv7UyO06k0GhUrUkr

5. Hollala (හොල්ලලා) — official lyrics video on YouTube. Music, mix and master by Shenal Maddumage.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/5WtyN9ckLqovq1ht8d955F
   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4pJ43aMS_u4

6. Doppi Nakin — Funky Dirt single.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/5hnHxcZ6xjJLXPSlRD9VdJ

7. Awidan Yanawa — 2021 collaboration with Yohani, featuring Shenal and Murshad. Music by Shenal Maddumage; lyrics by Murshad Huvais.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/7s2fLyvgcSOzuA0rBHuFSE
   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Hkwxj0rADFg

8. Bus Eke — 2013 single and a long-running fan favourite, with millions of YouTube views.
   https://open.spotify.com/track/421PPxgiHyH2qIe7rFxwuP

9. Eka Tamai Meka — 2014 single. Available on the band's official streaming profiles.

10. Ada Ape Thaththa — 2012 debut single. The music video won the band Best New Artist and Best Upcoming Artist honours.
    https://open.spotify.com/track/195l4MSZJXqsuFKa5Eu8vm
    https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=efCCmKmP4l8

Other catalogue titles include Ulaale La, Mun Nam Mara Minissu with VINI Production, Kiri Kiri Bole with Kaizer, Toyyo Bayyo and Pem Kathawaka.

## Booking and live performances

Funky Dirt performs at:

- Weddings
- Private parties
- Birthdays
- Corporate events
- Festivals
- College gigs
- International events

Booking process:

1. Open https://funkydirtmusic.com/#contact.
2. Enter your name, phone or WhatsApp number, event type, date, venue, expected crowd and optional budget.
3. Submit the form. It opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled booking request addressed to the band.
4. The band replies with availability and a quote.

Lead times:

- Weddings and private events: 3–6 months in advance.
- Major events and festivals: 6–12 months in advance.
- International bookings: more advance notice is needed for travel and logistics.

Each performance is tailored to the venue and budget, including set length, set list and technical setup. Must-play requests are accepted at booking, and live requests are welcome on the night.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who are the members of Funky Dirt?

Funky Dirt is a trio: Murshad Huvais (Mura) on vocals, lyrics and rap; Shenal Maddumage as producer, composer and mixing engineer; and Ridzy as DJ and beatmaker. Mura, Shenal and Ridzy formed the band in 2007 at Isipathana College, Colombo.

### Where is Funky Dirt from and when did the band form?

Funky Dirt is from Colombo, Sri Lanka. The trio formed in 2007 as a school band called MACS at Isipathana College before becoming Funky Dirt.

### What songs is Funky Dirt known for?

Funky Dirt is known for Sereppuwa, Ada Ape Thaththa, Bus Eke, Watey Gihin, Hollala, Doppi Nakin, Eka Tamai Meka and Awidan Yanawa with Yohani. Their 2025 single Oba Dakmen was the PPL official theme song.

### How can I listen to Funky Dirt?

Stream Funky Dirt on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and Deezer. Official music videos are on YouTube at @FunkyDirt_Official, and the band posts updates on Instagram and Facebook.

### How far in advance should I book Funky Dirt?

Book at least 3–6 months in advance for private events such as weddings, and 6–12 months for major events or festivals. The band's calendar fills up quickly during peak season, so earlier is better.

### How can I book Funky Dirt for an event?

Send a booking request through the form at https://funkydirtmusic.com/#contact. It opens WhatsApp with your event date, venue, event type and expected crowd, and the band replies with availability and a quote.

### What performance packages does Funky Dirt offer?

Funky Dirt performs at weddings, private parties, birthdays, corporate events, festivals and college gigs. Set length, set list and setup are tailored to the venue and budget.

### Does Funky Dirt perform outside Sri Lanka?

Yes. Funky Dirt takes international bookings and regularly performs overseas. International dates need more advance notice for travel and logistics.

### What happens if I need to cancel or reschedule?

Contact the band on WhatsApp as early as possible. Funky Dirt will try to reschedule if availability allows, and cancellation terms are agreed up front at booking time.

### Can I request specific songs for my event?

Yes. Send a must-play list when booking and the band will work it into the set. Live requests are also welcome on the night when the band knows the song.
